name: Help centre gap review
summary: Once a period, your support lead sees what the help centre is missing, read from that period's tickets and search log: questions agents answered by hand, articles that fell short, articles search could not find, and one gap list ranked by the tickets an article could have saved. The lead decides what is written.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own method, written for this template: sorting each ticket a customer could have settled alone by what the agent had to do (answer by hand, send a link, or send a link and correct it), reading the search log's empty searches against the articles' titles and tags, ranking the gaps by the tickets an article could have saved, and leaving every decision to the support lead.
